verdict.rationale: LegalZoom is an online legal-services SaaS platform, and such a platform could plausibly publish official SDKs or APIs, so this axis applies. The evidence pack contains no mention of any SDK, API, or developer library. The llms.txt file is guidance for AI crawlers, not a developer SDK, so it earns no credit.
